history.name: Recording a change that spans the product
history.description: A change with no single home — a wording pass across many screens, a change in what a colour means — is recorded against the release itself. It reads once at the end of the document as something that ran across the whole product, and no unrelated feature has to carry a note about it.
history.dev_notes: cmdOtherChange, appending to .ledger/other-changes.json with its own audience.
